summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of MSSP SOC KPI Dashboard. 46/46 backend pytest cases pass (auth, all 6 persona dashboards x 3 periods, CSV/XLSX upload, invalid inputs, no _id leaks). Frontend E2E covers login (form + all 6 quick-login persona buttons), executive overview (gauges, AI recommendations with P1-P4 tags, 8 KPI cards, 2 charts), theme toggle (dark/light class flip), navigation through all 6 pages, TimeTabs weekly/monthly/quarterly triggering fresh data, MITRE heatmap, analyst/rules tables, CSV upload modal, user menu, logout, invalid credentials. All flows working.

issues: Sonner toasts (e.g. after CSV upload success) render at top-right and overlap the user-menu-trigger for ~4s, briefly blocking clicks on the user avatar / theme toggle. Recommend either shorter toast duration, bottom-right positioning, or shifting the toast container so it doesn't overlap the header controls.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Reposition sonner toaster (top-center or bottom-right) so post-upload toast doesn't overlap the user menu / theme toggle in the header.
OPTIONAL: On SocManagerDashboard while data is loading, keep the 'Loading…' skeleton in the same spot; consider rendering KPI card skeletons for a smoother perceived load.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py wires the CORSMiddleware AFTER app.include_router(api). While it still applies (FastAPI processes middleware regardless of order), convention (and matching preflight header emission for /api routes) is to add CORS before include_router. Low-impact but worth tidying.

server.py sets `secure=False` on auth cookies in auth.set_auth_cookies — acceptable for preview but must be flipped to True in production HTTPS environments. Frontend currently uses Bearer localStorage token (axios withCredentials=false), so cookies are effectively unused; consider removing cookie plumbing OR moving frontend to withCredentials to reduce dual-path auth surface.

mock_data.py period-scoped values differ across weekly/monthly/quarterly but within a single period always yield the same numbers (deterministic hash). This is by design but the app description promises 'Live' badges on some KPIs (SOAR auto/manual closures) — those static numbers under a 'Live' label are misleading.
recommendations.py generates the 'Threat Intel actor elevated' rec unconditionally every call; small logic issue — should also gate on `total_advisories` or IOC hit-rate threshold.

auth.py seed_admin re-hashes admin password if it doesn't match ADMIN_PASSWORD env var, but does NOT do the same for the 5 persona demo users. If the demo passwords are ever rotated, the DB will hold stale hashes. Suggest applying the same update-on-mismatch pattern to persona users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after correct waits (37/37 across 2 runs); initial run had 3 timing-only fails I fixed with wait_for_selector

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — runs in ~5s with pytest-xdist. Covers auth, all 6 dashboards x 3 periods, CSV upload sources (qradar/xsoar/threat_intel), auth-required checks, invalid inputs, no _id leaks. For frontend, ALWAYS wait_for_selector on a specific KPI test-id (e.g. kpi-offenses) after navigation because React Query data load is async — a bare wait for the page container is not enough. Beware sonner toast overlap on top-right user menu; either wait 5s after upload or dismiss toast before clicking user-menu-trigger.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Initial 3 UI test failures were timing artifacts in the Playwright script (waited for page container but not for React-Query data-loaded KPIs). Fixed by waiting for a concrete KPI selector after navigation; all subsequent runs green.
